auth.title: Sign in to Samvad
auth.codeHint: We sent an email to {{email}}. Enter the code from it, or open its sign-in link in this browser.

errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send a new one.
errors.signupDisabled: New accounts are invite-only. Ask your clinic admin for access.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notAuthorized: This email can’t receive sign-in emails yet. The clinic’s email sender isn’t set up (custom SMTP).
errors.badEmail: That email address doesn’t look right.
errors.notConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, use Google, or choose “Forgot password?” to set a password.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password you haven’t used here before.
errors.providerDisabled: This sign-in method isn’t switched on yet.

auth.signInHint: Sign in with Google or your email and password.
auth.signUpHint: Enter your details below to create your Samvad account.
auth.forgotHint: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to choose a new password.
auth.useCode: Email me a sign-in code instead
auth.confirmSent: We sent an email to {{email}}. Enter the code from it, or open its link to finish creating your account.
auth.resetSent: If {{email}} has an account, we emailed it a code. Enter it here, or open the email’s link, to choose a new password.
auth.resetExpired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one from the sign-in page.
auth.newPasswordHint: Choose a password that meets every requirement below.

newPatient.title: New patient
newPatient.description: Add a patient in four short steps.
newPatient.languageHint: Then press Ctrl+Space: Samvad asks the patient each question aloud in this language and fills in the answers.
newPatient.noVoice: Voice interpretation isn’t available in {{language}}. The visit will use picture mode, and a human interpreter should be arranged.
newPatient.companion: Usually comes with a family member or carer
newPatient.allergiesHint: Leave empty if not known. Don’t write “none” unless the patient confirmed it.
newPatient.medicinesPlaceholder: e.g. metformin 500 mg twice a day
